result.notes:
DX06 is the only source. It is a secondary law-firm alert, and it says nothing about Providence buildings, unit counts, construction dates, owner occupancy or landlord size. It covers Providence only in the enforcement-case bullet and the table row ('Prohibits the use of rent-setting algorithms; the city expressly linked the measure to software such as RealPage'). Both describe the prohibited conduct and the penalties, not coverage.

I set the original summary to null. It asserted an absence ('states no building, unit-count or landlord-size limits') and that the definitions and exclusions are not captured. Neither statement can be backed by a verbatim passage, and the second is a review comment rather than a coverage fact.

I did not carry over the Portland condition in the same table ('for owners of 16 or more units') because it belongs to another jurisdiction.

The ordinance text (Providence Code ch. 13, art. X, §§ 13-69–13-73) is needed to determine any definitions of covered devices, landlord or unit thresholds, or exclusions. Until it is captured, every coverage field stays null and the list of unverifiable exemptions stays empty.
